relationships.rationale: Decision step 4: the aerosol and land surface products are written by the same Level 2 aerosol/surface PGE (one release: F07_0015 / F04_0015).

metadata_findings: 17 existing associations (12 INPUT, 5 PARENT) copy the inputs of the global product (e.g. MIB2GEOP, MI1B2T, MI1B2E, MIRCCM, …); by rule 1c-1 they are not inputs of the subset, whose only parent is MIL2ASAE.

6 associations give a version that CMR does not hold for that ShortName: MI1B2T '2' (CMR: ['003', '004']), MI1B2E '2' (CMR: ['003', '004']), MIRCCM '3' (CMR: ['004']), MIANACP '2' (CMR: ['001']), MIANCAGP '2' (CMR: ['001']), MIRCCM '2' (CMR: ['004']).

5 associations write the Version without the leading zeros CMR uses, so they do not resolve: MIB2GEOP '2' (CMR: ['002', '003']), MIANCARP '2' (CMR: ['002']), MIANCAGP '1' (CMR: ['001']), MIANACP '1' (CMR: ['001']), MIANTASC '2' (CMR: ['002']).
4 associations name ShortNames that are not CMR collections: MIANLDBM, MIANSMT, MIANTOAC, MICNFG.
No association to the global product it was cut from (MIL2ASAE).
